status: PASS: independent complete staged keyboard plot source review; root installation and qualification remain pending
scope: Keyboard inspection only; P04-23 consumer author is independent of Codec keyboard implementation
checks: All frozen header/CPP, complete patch, author notes, manifest/capsule and exact P04-23 before images read. Every declared artifact rehashed; regenerated unified patch equals the frozen patch.19 complete original definitions are independently lexed byte-identical, including all factories, counter selection, bound/date validation, labels, exact signed tooltips and finite coordinate math.

StrongFocus is added without changing source ownership. Key handler accepts only unmodified Left/Right/Home/End while visible, nonminimized, focused and bound to a frame. Other keys/modifiers/inactive states delegate to QWidget. The event is accepted before any tooltip/accessibility publication; no receiver member is touched after selectBucket returns, allowing direct callback deletion.

Frame construction is private and all retained factories produce exactly24/7/168 nonempty buckets. First Left/Right/Home selects0, End selects last, subsequent arrows clamp without wrapping or skipping unknowns. Selection is scalar optional<size_t>; no old packet/widget/source DTO is added. Each accepted new frame resets selection before outward properties.

Keyboard narration uses the unchanged bucketToolTip: exact full UTC date/hour or daily date, chosen Payload/Protocol/DHT names and signed int64 values, with Unknown distinct from0. Full tooltip and accessible description remain unelided; visible caption only flattens/elides that same text. No sum, rate, narrowing or independent expected-value arithmetic is introduced.

Every accepted frame/key mutation advances a checked uint64 interaction revision; exhaustion refuses further mutations rather than reuse. selectBucket validates the index, computes text from a retained immutable frame, then rechecks QPointer+frame+revision before committing. Tooltip is published before accessible description with a post-publication current() check, so direct deletion, frame replacement or nested keyboard mutation on the same frame prevents older follow-up writes.

replace computes new strings before mutation, then admits QPointer+old frame+old interaction revision and increments once. After assigning frame/resetting selection it rechecks exact new frame+revision after AccessibleName, AccessibleDescription and ToolTip properties. All three public setters also capture/recheck revision around factory/source lifetime, preserving nested same-frame key changes as well as replacement/deletion.

Mouse tooltip computation now checks the interaction revision before and after ToolTipChange. Existing mouseMove/event entry definitions remain exact and avoid further QWidget dispatch if a property callback supersedes or destroys the receiver. Hover remains independent: it does not move the keyboard selection or change its retained accessible description/caption.

Focus in/out copy QPointer/frame/revision before delegating to QWidget and only repaint if still current afterward. Losing focus retains selection/description/caption but hides the selection guide/outlines; no focus handler changes data or invokes readers. Style focus rectangle and local repaint are the only additions.

Painting retains the immutable frame and selected scalar locally. With no selection the chart rectangle remains exact; a selected caption reserves24 additional bottom pixels. X-guide is computed over the bounded bucket index even for unknown values. Only existing frame.point results get known-point outlines, so unknowns gain no Y point and existing gaps/series are not filled. Full signed finite coordinate code is unchanged.

No timer, IO/read request, new worker/signal/lease, saved state, clipboard update or original Java runtime is introduced. This stage does not implement later P04-25 Copy. Public selectedBucket getter exposes bounded scalar state only.
qualification_gates: Actual offscreen tests must exercise all three frame sizes/traffic choices, unknown/knownzero/fullsigned captions, key bounds/focus/hidden/minimized delegation and replacement reset against these installed hashes.

Actual ToolTipChange and QAccessible property callbacks must exercise deletion, frame replacement and nested keys on the same immutable frame; source checks alone do not establish platform callback delivery or screen-reader acceptance.

Qt6.12 changed-only accessibility notification is an existing dependency behavior cited by the author, not a new reviewer runtime observation. No synthetic accessibility event or real compositor/screen-reader acceptance is credited.

Root must preserve P04-23 behavior/accounting/fixtures, qualify the separately frozen new tests and actual smoke/captures, and bind final source/metadata/rollback evidence before declaring P04-24 complete. The full request continues to P04-25.
scope_limits: Review covers application-controlled ordinary Qt widgets/styles and the explicit tooltip/accessibility/reentry boundaries. It does not establish immunity to arbitrary user-supplied Qt translation/style/plugin callbacks during painting or Qt internal implementation behavior.
No compiler, preprocessor, target definition evaluation/import, native/Qt/Java/mock/test/GUI execution, Git command/mutation or native edit occurred.
